notations: Sigma = distinguishability x evidence_assessment x contradiction x missingness x supersession x inference
note: SO-EXP-05 partially discharges the commissioned-but-unwritten Step 272 by applying its own named minimal-sufficient-statistic method to its own six named sources (distinguishability, evidence_assessment, contradiction, missingness, supersession, inference), modelled as observable facts. Result: 56 coherent situations, 9 mandatory distinctions from class-1/2 operations, coarsest partition = 50 equivalence classes; all 6 sources are irreducible over the full product, but restricting to the epistemic-only projection (distinguishability, evidence_assessment, contradiction, missingness) yields 14 states collapsing to 13 minimum values under 7 preserved distinctions. Two of Step 272's six named sources (supersession, inference) are found not to be epistemic at all, so a Sigma built from all six would re-conflate exactly the separation Step 272 itself demands.

SO-EXP-06 re-marks the first-order 29-node canonical dependency graph with second-order findings, using the mandate's seven node states, several of which reverse first-order marks (Authority now CLOSED/NORMATIVE with no outgoing edge, breaking the 7-node cycle Assertion->Evidence->Rule->Policy->Authority->Assertion; K, Operation, T_algebra, Equivalence now CLOSED/PARAMETRIC). aliases: Determination lost between DDD and formalization bands
note: Second-order finding (03-DETERMINATION-SCOPE-ANALYSIS.md): Determination is fully specified as an aggregate root with type, invariant, DRAFT->PROPOSED->FINALIZED lifecycle and domain events in the DDD/architecture band (Steps 155-178, esp. 157.22 and 165.8), but occurs 0 times in the six terminal formalization-band steps (262-271) with no terminal step ever saying it is out of scope or retained externally -- an unrecorded band-transition loss (DS-1), the third instance of this failure mode alongside the repaired measure-theory model (EV-A2) and the vanished Regime object (UL-9). DS-2: even under the corpus's own Model D, the object Determination is typed but the CONDITIONAL structure (the rule/Method) that produces it is not -- this is downstream of, not separate from, the still-open Policy-typing work (Step 271 marks Policy internal structure RED).

The canonical-construction pass derives K by a removal test over the 14 operations forced by the corpus's own non-collapse laws (not by patching the terminal K=(A,R)): every one of eight components (A assertions, D_t recognised dimensions, R relations, Sigma_c epistemic-state carrier, E_L evidence links, Pi origin, t temporal, H history) is load-bearing for at least one forced operation. Executed band-invariance test (bandtest.py) shows K's required components are IDENTICAL across all 16 subsets of the undetermined 4-operation band {Transform, Merge, Split, Reintroduce}, so D-1 (which band members are mandatory) does not block construction of K -- it affects only the operation registry. Result: 𝒦=(K,H) with K=(D_t,A,R,Sigma_c,E_L), Pi and t carried inside each assertion, H external and reachable only via the class-4 audit operation Replay. Explicitly established as SEMANTIC necessity only (each component must be expressible), not REPRESENTATION necessity (whether each is a stored top-level field) -- Sigma_c and E_L are flagged as the two components where this distinction bites, pending Step 273's own Model A/B/C deletion tests (-> D-4).

Three new human-decision items beyond the carried-and-narrowed D-1/D-2/D-3: D-0 (urgent) -- was O_core actually decided? Step 273 works from 'the verified semantic operation universe O_core' citing an 'attached HPA response' that is not in the repository, O_core occurs only inside that one research file, and governance-notes.md (through GN-73) has zero entries for O_core or Steps 271-273 -- a decision reported in a Stratum-1 research narrative with no authority record is not an authority act. D-4 -- is Sigma stored or derived (Step 273 Model A/B/C); recommendation is explicitly to NOT decide and let Step 273's own deletion/replacement tests finish. D-5 -- should R be restored to the corpus's 8-tuple r=(E1,E2,T,R,Q,E,Sigma,tau) from the terminal 5-field triple ℛ⊆A x A x RelationType, which forecloses evidencing/dating/superseding/contesting a relation; blocked because v0.2 is authorized and md5-pinned, so restoring it is a governance act, not a verification one.

aliases: minimal state representation sufficient to preserve mandatory distinctions
note: Step 273 mandate: derive (not restate) the smallest information structure constituting a Knowledge State K given the operation universe O_core, treating K_c=(A,R,Sigma,E_L) as a starting hypothesis. Introduces the deletion test (does removing component X cause some mandatory operation to lose a distinction?) and the replacement test (is a required component derivable/reconstructible rather than primitive, e.g. E_L=f(R)?), explicitly distinguishing 'required' from 'primitive' and 'semantic necessity' from 'representation necessity'. Poses Sigma as Model A (single status), Model B (structured tuple), or Model C (derived f(A,R,E)) and explicitly declines to decide in advance. Also raises: Proposition vs Assertion identity distinction, Unknown vs NotRepresented, Refuted vs False, three candidate state-equality relations (representation/structural/observational), and a 12-item counterexample catalogue requirement.

Step 274 mandate: define Valid_K as a state-space predicate, and require WellFormed(K) to be kept strictly distinct from EpistemicallyConsistent(K) -- a KnowledgeOS state may represent P and not-P simultaneously and be WellFormed=true while EpistemicallyConsistent=false. Splits operations into read operations o_r:K x X -> Y and state transitions o_t:K x X -/->K', requiring closure K in K-candidate and Pre(K,x) => Post(K,x,K') and K' in K-candidate, with partiality explicitly legitimate (OperationalFailure != InvalidState). Poses candidate core transitions (Assert, Retract, Supersede, Contest, Assess, Merge, Derive, QualifyEvidence) each with open semantic questions (e.g. three competing Retract models: deletion / retained-with-lifecycle-status / relation; Merge must not assume K1 union K2 and may need to preserve {P, not-P} as unresolved rather than auto-resolved). Requires algebraic-property testing (associativity/commutativity/idempotence/monotonicity) without assuming any holds, a fixed-policy computational-closure milestone before tackling policy-varying T, and an anti-circularity ordering PrimitiveTypes -> WellFormedness -> OperationPreconditions -> Transition -> Closure.

aliases: epistemic vs lifecycle vs governance vs temporal vs provenance
note: Step 275 mandate, triggered by an adversarial audit partially refuting both the three-state Sigma={Unknown,Supported,Refuted} (cannot represent degree of support) and the five-dimensional Sigma=(A,S,R,V,C) (mixes epistemic, acquisition, lifecycle, temporal and conflict concepts). Requires classifying every status-like corpus term (Unknown, Supported, Refuted, Conflicted, Contested, Accepted, Validated, Superseded, Approved, Acquisition-terms, Resolution-terms) by which semantic dimension it answers, hypothesising the decomposition StatusLikeInformation = Epistemic (+) Lifecycle (+) Governance (+) Temporal (+) Provenance, and proposing candidate minimal epistemic structure Sigma_epi=(D,S) with D an epistemic-direction triple and S a 5-level ordinal support scale -- explicitly warning against inferring cardinal arithmetic on S (Strong != 3) absent a justified measurement scale, and against manufacturing probability absent an established (Omega,F,P). Distinguishes Unknown from Missing (governed-artifact-absent vs no-evidence-either-way) and Confidence from SupportStrength. States three unacceptable shortcuts: 'three states => Sigma solved', 'five dimensions => Sigma solved', '24 vocabulary terms => 24 epistemic states'.

Step 276 exists in three successive self-correcting layers within this session, each rewriting the prior verdict rather than continuing it. Layer 1 (identical mandate text in two files) requires an audit (not new theory) using an evidence hierarchy [E]xplicit/[D]erived/e[X]perimental/[I]mplementation/[R]econstruction/[N]ormative and a six-state closure classification (CLOSED/CONDITIONALLY CLOSED/PARAMETRIC/OPEN/CONTRADICTED/REQUIRES NORMATIVE DECISION), identifying O_core as the first-priority dependency. Layer 2 ('revised') introduces four ORTHOGONAL closure dimensions -- Semantic, Formal, Computational, Governance closure -- explicitly warning they must never again be conflated, and reaches optimistic marks (K, Sigma, Evidence, Identity, Equality: CLOSED; O_core: layered O_S/O_E/O_H/O_G/O_Q/O_X union, 'structurally closed' with O_G not uniformly computationally demonstrated; Policy/Authority: SemanticClosed+FormallyPartial+ComputationallyConditional+GovernanceOpen), concluding Core Theory approx Closed / Governance Interface != Closed, and recommends Step 277 = Policy/Authority interface formalization. Layer 3 ('corrected audit', appended in the same file as Layer 2) explicitly WITHDRAWS Layer 2's conclusion ('Foundations are overwhelmingly closed') as too strong, introduces a four-level Defined != Derived != Demonstrated != Closed hierarchy, downgrades most of Layer 2's CLOSED marks to OPEN/CANDIDATE/CRITERION-ESTABLISHED-SATISFACTION-OPEN, corrects the O_core=O_S union...union O_X formula as merely an 'operation inventory' not a 'proven minimal mathematical universe' (mixing state-transitions, queries, governance predicates and representation operations), and redirects Step 277 to Canonical Transformation Inventory and O_core Closure instead of Policy formalization.

aliases: Assert Retract Supersede Merge Split LinkEvidence
note: Step 277 (successor to Step 276 Layer 3) reduces the previously heterogeneous ~20-operation O_core to a five-layer typed model (state transformations O_T / evidence O_E / query-observation O_Q / governance O_G / representation O_R), on the ground that Assert (state-changing), Query (observing) and Authorize (governance predicate) cannot form one homogeneous algebra. Isolates a candidate primitive state-transition kernel T_candidate={Assert, Retract, Supersede, Merge, Split, LinkEvidence}, explicitly not yet proven minimal, with Replay reframed as a derived fold over transformation history (Replay(K0,H)=fold(T,K0,H)) rather than primitive, and Trace/Query/Explain reclassified as observational rather than state-changing. Introduces the canonical partial-transition schema t:K x I_t -/-> K with explicit Pre_t/Post_t, and the operation-minimality criterion 'o is primitive iff some mandatory distinction r is not in Closure(T_K minus {o})'. Nine falsification tests (T1-T9) are specified for the next step to run (Assert/Retract/Supersede/Merge/Split/LinkEvidence elimination tests, Replay-as-fold, Policy-independence, Representation-independence).

Step 278 exists in three successive layers. Layer 1 defines the Policy-Authority integration model: Verdict as a tagged union including a structured Conditional(RequiredConditions,SatisfiedConditions,MissingConditions,ResolutionStrategy in {WAIT,REQUEST,ESCALATE,REASSESS,BLOCK}) distinct from Unknown; recommends Constitutional Authority as the non-circular root (Constitution -> Authority -> Policy -> Authorization -> Operation); defines policy versioning/immutability/temporal validity as half-open intervals, deny-over-permit Authorization=Combine(PolicyVerdict,AuthorityVerdict) precedence table, and the ontology correction 'governance Policy not-in K, but knowledge ABOUT policy in K'; introduces four independent closure dimensions Formal/Computational/Empirical/Governance (FC/CC/EC/GC) that may be set independently (e.g. FC=1,CC=0,EC=0,GC=1); specifies F1-F13 falsification tests. Layer 2 is Layer 1 plus an appended supervisory review that CONDITIONALLY ACCEPTS it while flagging twelve underspecified areas (policy-evaluation algorithm, Combine's condition-merging, statistical-model integration, policy-version identity, eventual-consistency mechanism, non-executable falsification tests, unenforced DDD invariants, imprecise closure terminology, underspecified Step 279 deliverables, measurement-evidence integration, unoperationalized rule independence, missing calibration model). Layer 3 ('FINAL') answers all twelve, replacing the closure vocabulary with five explicit states (OPEN/FORMALLY SPECIFIED/COMPUTATIONALLY PARAMETRIC/EMPIRICALLY CLOSED/GOVERNANCE CLOSED), adding a policy-content-addressed identity model (PID=Hash(...)), three independence classes (structural/logical/statistical, explicitly distinct), a measurement/calibration model with scale-typing (nominal/ordinal/interval/ratio), five new falsification tests F9-F13, and a mandatory rule 'overlap without a resolution rule => INVALID', concluding Policy/Authority in C1 (formally specified), pending Step 279 (executable implementation) and Step 280 (end-to-end empirical closure test); no theory-completeness claim is made at any layer.
